class: Any reconciliation that decides what happened from an end-of-period NET quantity alone treats every round trip inside that period (buy then sell of the same contract, or the reverse) as 'nothing happened': the trades, their fills and their P&L vanish. Wider shape: a summary number cannot prove the absence of the events it sums.
mechanism: 2026-10-19: PR #421 (#352-1) resolves an earlier-day open plan from Kite's next-day positions net; reconcile_attribution.py:35-36 (branch build/352-1-next-day, 21ba2c389ff8) documents that an ENTRY filled and sold by hand on Kite the same day leaves the net at the base and closes the plan nothing_placed with no mismatch.

first_seen.where: PR #421 round-2 read-only Opus review (GC-6 row REVIEW-421)
first_seen.evidence: reconcile_attribution.py:35-36 'Documented limit: with no other holder on the contract, an ENTRY filled and sold by hand on Kite the same earlier day leaves the net at the base and reads nothing_placed'; ADR-111 requires a recorded mismatch for a hand close.

fix: Open: GC-6 row NET-ROUNDTRIP. Never close an earlier-day plan nothing_placed on net alone when activity on the contract cannot be ruled out; else unresolved_from_positions.

detection.note: Discriminating proof: a derived next-day reply with net at the base but day buy 65 / sell 65 must close unresolved, while one with no activity closes nothing_placed.

occurrences.evidence: documented limit in the docstring; no test covers the round trip
